SrcPattern: SELECT UNIQUE {for <value> in <values: LIST[ANY_VALUE]> ADD ',': <value>} FROM {for <table> in <tables: LIST[TABLE]> ADD ',': <table>}
TgtPattern: SELECT DISTINCT {for <value> in <values> ADD ',': <value>} FROM {for <table> in <tables> ADD ',': <table>}

SrcPattern: SELECT <ele_list: LIST[ANY_VALUE]> FROM <tbl_list: LIST[TABLE]> WHERE ROWNUM \<= <row_num: INT_LITERAL, [1,5]>

SELECT <col_list: LIST[ANY_VALUE, GROUP_BY]>, <alias_list: LIST[ALIAS]>
FROM (
    SELECT <col_list>, <aggr_col: ANY_VALUE, GROUP_BY>,  <col: NUMBER>
    FROM <tables: LIST[TABLE]>
) PIVOT (
    SUM(<col>)
    FOR <aggr_col> 
    IN ({for <value>, <alias> in <sample_values: @SampleValue(<aggr_col>)>, <alias_list: LIST[ALIAS]> ADD ', ': <value> AS <alias>})
) AS <table_alias:ALIAS>

SELECT <col_list: LIST[ANY_VALUE, GROUP_BY]>, <alias_list: LIST[ALIAS]>
FROM (
    SELECT <col_list>, <aggr_col: ANY_VALUE, GROUP_BY>,  <col: NUMBER>
    FROM <tables: LIST[TABLE]>
) PIVOT (
    COUNT(<col>)
    FOR <aggr_col> 
    IN ({for <value>, <alias> in <sample_values: @SampleValue(<aggr_col>)>, <alias_list: LIST[ALIAS]> ADD ', ': <value> AS <alias>})
) AS <table_alias:ALIAS>
